actionable_findings.problem: Design states framed downstream trailers are independent of Content-Length while preserving H1/H2 restrictions, but the task list does not explicitly select/test H3 fixed-length response trailers. Existing trailers_supported? rejects Content-Length for all versions. Adding H3 to allowed versions alone does not resolve this distinction.
actionable_findings.recommended_resolution: State explicitly whether H3 response Content-Length plus declared safe trailers is accepted, and add the exact H3 Headers.response and actual wire regression while retaining unchanged H1/H2 rejection assertions. Existing framed response semantics already support fixed-stream finish with trailers.

actionable_findings.problem: Completed-before-ready task omits explicit terminal-operation/race assertions from its design invariant. A read-only source trace shows ready currently sets upload then pump skips read whenever body_complete?; ordering repairs could also accidentally reopen upload after an early origin final head.
actionable_findings.recommended_resolution: Add deterministic ready-before/after-done scenarios requiring exactly-one public finish_body with ordered trailers at original D, nil-upload zero finish, and ready after early final head never reopens/finishes a stopped upload. Avoid scheduler timing as readiness proof.

actionable_findings.problem: Plan preserves authentication/destination policy and records upstream headers, but does not identify exact origin policy assertions. Without them source/wire proof could show body translation while missing identity/header-policy regressions.
actionable_findings.recommended_resolution: Require independent origin fixed Host, regenerated X-Forwarded-* and absence of spoofed Forwarded/X-Real-IP/hop values. Preserve and execute current forbidden/auth-sensitive trailer-declaration rejection and destination/authentication regressions. Dropped forwarding/hop fields and rejected forbidden declarations remain distinct; no forward-proxy expansion.
